00005   FUNCTION arrhenius(a,b,c)
00006     ! This function calculates rate-coefficients based on the

00015   FUNCTION green_mcneal(energy,a,j,nu,omega,z,i)
00016     !
00017     !  Purpose:
00018     !    To calculate the Green-McNeal scaled proton cross-sections
00019     !  as described in Miller & Green 1971.
00020     !
00021     !  Note:
00022     !    This formula can be used for both excitation and ionization
00023     !  cross-sections, given the appropriate input.
00024     !
00025     !! GREEN_MCNEAL !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00026     IMPLICIT NONE
00027 
00028     ! Data dictionary: declare calling parameters
00029     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: green_mcneal
00030     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: energy
00031     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: a
00032     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: j !units of eV
00033     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: nu
00034     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: omega
00035     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: z !atomic number of the TARGET!
00036     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: i !ionization energy in eV
00037 
00038     ! Data dictionary: declare local vals
00039     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: numerator
00040     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: denominator
00041 
00042     ! Initialize values
00043     green_mcneal = 0
00044     numerator    = 0
00045     denominator  = 0
00046 
00047     ! Perform calculation
00048     numerator    = ((z*a)**omega)*((energy)**nu)
00049     numerator    = numerator*1.E-16
00050     denominator  = (j**(omega + nu)) + (energy**(omega+nu))
00051     green_mcneal = numerator/denominator
00052     RETURN
00053   END FUNCTION green_mcneal

00055   FUNCTION a_gs(energy,k,k_b,j,j_b,j_c)
00056     !
00057     !  Purpose:
00058     !    To calculate the A(E) prefactor for the Green-Sawada (1973) electron
00059     !  impact cross-sections.
00060     !
00061     !! A_GS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00062     IMPLICIT NONE
00063 
00064     ! Data dictionary: declare calling parameters
00065     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: a_gs
00066     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: energy
00067     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: k
00068     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: k_b
00069     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: j
00070     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: j_b
00071     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: j_c
00072 
00073     ! Data dictionary: declare local vals
00074     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: factor1
00075     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: factor2
00076 
00077     ! Initialize values
00078     a_gs = 0
00079     factor1 = 0
00080     factor2 = 0
00081 
00082     ! Carry out computation
00083     factor1 = (k/energy + k_b)
00084     factor2 = energy/j + j_b + j_c/energy
00085     a_gs    = factor1*DLOG(factor2)
00086     RETURN
00087   END FUNCTION a_gs

00171   FUNCTION green_sawada(a,gamma_fac,t_max,t_0)
00172     !
00173     !  Purpose:
00174     !    To calculate the Green-Sawada (1973) electron
00175     !  impact cross-sections.
00176     !
00177     !! GREEN_SAWADA !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00178     IMPLICIT NONE
00179 
00180     ! Data dictionary: declare calling parameters
00181     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: green_sawada
00182     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: a
00183     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: gamma_fac
00184     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: t_max
00185     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: t_0
00186 
00187     ! Data dictionary: declare local vals
00188     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: bracket
00189     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: paren
00190     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: insides
00191 
00192     ! Initialize values
00193     green_sawada = 0
00194     bracket = 0
00195     paren = 0
00196     insides = 0
00197 
00198     ! Perform calculation
00199     bracket = (t_max - t_0)/gamma_fac
00200     ! PRINT *, "Inside atan1=",bracket
00201     paren   = t_0/gamma_fac
00202     ! PRINT *, "Inside atan2=", paren
00203     insides = ATAN(bracket) + ATAN(paren)
00204     ! PRINT *, "insides are ", insides
00205     green_sawada = 1E-16*a*gamma_fac*insides
00206     RETURN
00207   END FUNCTION green_sawada

00213     !  cross-section as taken from Miller & Green 1971.
00214     !
00215     !! NE_MG !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00216     IMPLICIT NONE
00217

00219     REAL             :: ne_mg

00221     REAL, INTENT(IN) :: t_0
00222     REAL, INTENT(IN) :: t_max

00224     ! Data dictionary: declare local vals
00225     REAL             :: part1
00226     REAL             :: part2
00227 
00228     ! Initialize values
00229     ne_mg = 0
00230     part1 = 0
00231     part2 = 0
00232 
00233     ! Perform calculation
00234     part1 = ATAN((t_max - t_0)/gamma_fac)
00235     part2 = ATAN(t_0/gamma_fac)

00240   SUBROUTINE magic(eps,b,c2,s2,theta)
00241     !
00242     !  The famous Magic formula described in Biersack and Haggmark 1980
00243     !
00244     !
00245     !  Purpose:
00246     !   To calculate the center-of-mass scattering angle for a given potential
00247     !  using the formalism developed by Biersack and Haggmark. This algorithm
00248     !  is the same as is used in TRIM and SRIM by Ziegler.
00249     !
00250     !! MAGIC !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00251     IMPLICIT NONE
00252 
00253     !Data dictionary: Calling Parameters and Output
00254     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN)  :: eps
00255     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN)  :: b
00256     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT) :: c2,s2
00257     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT) :: theta
00258 
00259     !Data dictionary: Local Variables
00260     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: r, rr
00261     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: ex1,ex2,ex3,ex4
00262     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: v,v1
00263     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: fr,fr1
00264     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: q
00265     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: roc
00266     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: sqe
00267     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: cc,aa,ff
00268     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: delta
00269     DOUBLE PRECISION              :: co
00270 
00271 
00272     ! Initialize values
00273     c2    = 0
00274     s2    = 0
00275     theta = 0
00276     r     = 0
00277     rr    = 0
00278     ex1   = 0
00279     ex2   = 0
00280     ex3   = 0
00281     ex4   = 0
00282     v     = 0
00283     v1    = 0
00284     fr    = 0
00285     fr1   = 0
00286     q     = 0
00287     roc   = 0
00288     sqe   = 0
00289     cc    = 0
00290     aa    = 0
00291     ff    = 0
00292     delta = 0
00293     co    = 0
00294 
00295     ! Perform calculation
00296     r     = b
00297     rr    = -2.7*DLOG(eps*b)
00298     IF ( rr .LT. b ) GOTO 1980
00299     rr    = -2.7*DLOG(eps*b)
00300     IF ( rr .LT. b ) GOTO 1980
00301     r     = rr
00302 1980 ex1   =  0.18175*EXP(-3.1998*r)
00303     ex2   =  0.50986*EXP(-0.94229*r)
00304     ex3   =  0.28022*EXP(-0.4029*r)
00305     ex4   = 0.028171*EXP(-0.20162*r)
00306     v     = (ex1 + ex2 + ex3 + ex4)/r
00307     v1    = -(v+3.1998*ex1+0.94229*ex2+0.4029*ex3+0.20162*ex4)/r
00308     fr    = b*b/r+v*r/eps-r
00309     fr1   = -b*b/(r*r)+(v+v1*r)/eps-1.0
00310     q     = fr/fr1
00311     r     = r-q
00312     IF ( ABS(q/r) .GT. 0.001) GOTO 1980
00313     roc   = -2.0*(eps-v)/v1
00314     sqe   = SQRT(eps)
00315     cc    = (0.011615+sqe)/(0.0071222+sqe)
00316     aa    = 2.0*eps*(1.0+(0.99229/sqe))*b**cc
00317     ff    = (SQRT(aa**2+1.0)-aa)*((9.3066+eps)/(14.813+eps))
00318     delta = (r-b)*aa*ff/(ff+1.0)
00319     co    = (b+delta+roc)/(r+roc)
00320     c2    = co*co
00321     s2    = 1.0-c2
00322     theta = 2.0*ACOS(co)
00323     RETURN
00324   END SUBROUTINE magic
00325 
00326   FUNCTION b_magic(rn,a,rho)
00327     !
00328     !  Purpose:
00329     !   To calculate the reduced impact parameter based on a uniform random
00330     !  number and a screening length.
00331     !
00332     !! B_MAGIC !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00333     IMPLICIT NONE
00334 
00335     !Data dictionary: Calling parameters
00336     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: rn
00337     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: rho

00340 
00341     !Data dictionary: Local variables
00342     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: p
00343 
00344 
00345     ! Initialize values
00346     b_magic = 0
00347     p       = 0
00348 
00349     ! Perform calculation
00350     p = SQRT(rn/(3.14159*(rho**(2./3.))))
00351     b_magic = p/a

00376   FUNCTION eps(en,z1,z2,m1,m2,au)
00377     !
00378     !  Purpose:
00379     !   To calculate the Lindhard-Scharff-Sigmund reduced energy.
00380     !
00381     !! EPS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00382 
00383     !Note: All units must be Gaussian-CGS
00384     IMPLICIT NONE
00385 
00386     !Data dictionary: Calling parameters
00387     DOUBLE PRECISION, POINTER    :: en
00388     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: z1,z2
00389     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: m1,m2
00390     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: au
00391     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: eps
00392 
00393     !Data dictionary: Local variables
00394     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: fac1,fac2,fac3
00395 
00396     ! Initialize values
00397     eps = 0
00398     fac1 = 0
00399     fac2 = 0
00400     fac3 = 0
00401 
00402     ! Perform calculation
00403     fac1 = au/ECHARG2
00404     fac2 = m2/(m1+m2)
00405     fac3 = 1./(z1+z2)
00406     eps = en*fac1*fac2*fac3
00407   END FUNCTION eps

00435     !  collision between a target species and an incoming ion. This value

00450     ! Initialize values
00451     t_coll = 0
00452

00458   FUNCTION lab_theta(cmtheta,m1,m2)
00459     !
00460     !  Purpose:
00461     !   To calculate the laboratory frame of reference scattering angle based
00462     !  on the output of the Magic Formula, from which the model calculated the
00463     !  center-of-mass scattering angle.
00464     !
00465     !! LAB_THETA !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00466     IMPLICIT NONE
00467 
00468     !Data dictionary: Calling parameters
00469     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: cmtheta
00470     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: m1,m2
00471     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: lab_theta
00472 
00473     !Data dictionary: Local variables
00474     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: insides
00475 
00476 
00477     ! Initialize values
00478     lab_theta = 0
00479     insides   = 0
00480 
00481     ! Perform calculation
00482     insides = SIN(cmtheta)/(COS(cmtheta)+(m1/m2))

00487   FUNCTION sneps(eps)
00488     !
00489     !  Purpose:
00490     !   To calculate the reduced energy elastic stopping cross-section of
00491     !  nuclear collisions between a target and incoming ion.
00492     !
00493     !! SNEPS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00494     IMPLICIT NONE
00495 
00496     !Data dictionart: Calling Parameters
00497     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: eps
00498     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: sneps
00499 
00500     !Data dictionary: Local variables
00501     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: num
00502     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: den1,den2,den3,den
00503 
00504     ! Initialize values
00505     sneps = 0
00506     num   = 0
00507     den1  = 0
00508     den2  = 0
00509     den3  = 0
00510     den   = 0
00511 
00512     ! Perform calculation
00513     IF ( eps .LE. 30. ) THEN
00514        num = DLOG(1.+1.1383*eps)
00515        den1 = eps
00516        den2 = 0.01321*(eps**0.21226)
00517        den3 = 0.19593*(eps**0.5)
00518        den  = 2*(den1+den2+den3)
00519        sneps = num/den
00520     ELSE
00521        sneps = DLOG(eps)/(2*eps)
00522     END IF
00523     RETURN
00524   END FUNCTION sneps
00525 
00526   FUNCTION sne(sneps,z1,z2,m1,m2)
00527     !
00528     !  Purpose:
00529     !   To calculate the elastic stopping cross-section, S(E,T) of nuclear
00530     !  collisions between a target and incoming ion.
00531     !
00532     !! SNE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00533 
00534     IMPLICIT NONE
00535 
00536     !Data dicionary: Calling parameters
00537     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: sneps
00538     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: z1,z2
00539     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: m1,m2
00540     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: sne
00541 
00542     !Data dictionary: Local variables
00543     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: num,den
00544     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: den1,den2
00545 
00546     ! Initialize values
00547     sne  = 0
00548     num  = 0
00549     den  = 0
00550     den1 = 0
00551     den2 = 0
00552 
00553     num = (8.462E-15)*z1*z2*m1*sneps
00554     den1 = m1 + m2
00555     den2 = z1**0.23 + z2**0.23
00556     den = den1*den2
00557 
00558     sne = num/den
00559     RETURN
00560   END FUNCTION sne

00562   FUNCTION pelsig(energy,sne,mf)
00563     !
00564     !  Purpose:
00565     !   To calculate the elastic proton cross-section, sigma(E) of nuclear
00566     !  collisions between a target and incoming ion.

00570     !! PELSIG !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

00587   FUNCTION greendutta(energy,w,f,o,a,b)
00588     !
00589     !  Purpose:
00590     !   To calculate the Green & Dutta (1967) excitation cross-sections
00591     !  for forbidden transitions caused by electron impact.
00592     !
00593     !  NB:
00594     !    For further explanation of the formula used, see Jackman, Garvey, &
00595     !  Green 1977.
00596     !
00597     !  OUTPUT:
00598     !    The output of this function is an array of cross-sections, the number
00599     !  of which equals the number of forbidden states included in the struct.
00600     !
00601     !! GREENDUTTA !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00602     IMPLICIT NONE
00603 
00604     ! Data dictionary: Calling parameters
00605     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: energy !eV
00606     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN) :: w,f,o,a,b
00607     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: greendutta
00608 
00609     ! Local variables
00610     DOUBLE PRECISION             :: fac1,fac2,fac3
00611 
00612     ! Initialize values
00613     greendutta = 0
00614     fac1       = 0
00615     fac2       = 0
00616     fac3       = 0
00617 
00618     ! Perform calculation
00619     IF ( energy .LT. w ) THEN
00620        greendutta  = 0D0
00621     ELSE
00622        fac1       = (Q0*f)/(w*w)
00623        fac2       = (1.-(w/energy)**a)**b
00624        fac3       = (w/energy)**o
00625        greendutta = fac1*fac2*fac3
00626     END IF
00627     RETURN
00628   END FUNCTION greendutta

00630   FUNCTION pjgsigma(energy,f,w,c,a,b)
00631     !
00632     !  Purpose:
00633     !   To calculate the Porter, Jackman, Green (1976) excitation cross-section
00634     !  for allowed transitions caused by electron impact.
00635     !
00636     !  NB:
00637     !    For further explanation of the formula used, see Jackman, Garvey, &
00638     !  Green 1977.
00639     !
00640     !  OUTPUT:
00641     !    The output of this function is an array of cross-sections, the number
00642     !  of which equals the number of allowed states included in the struct.
00643     !
00644     !! PJGSIGMA !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00645     IMPLICIT NONE
00646 
00647     ! Calling parameters
00648     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN)                                :: energy
00649     DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(IN)                                :: f,w,c,a,b
00650     DOUBLE PRECISION                                            :: pjgsigma
00651 
00652     ! Local variables
00653     DOUBLE PRECISION                                            :: num, den, insides
00654 
00655     ! Initialize values
00656     pjgsigma = 0
00657     num      = 0
00658     den      = 0
